decisive_items: recurrent episodes of polymorphic ventricular tachycardia, some deteriorating into ventricular fibrillation
variant of unknown significance in the coding gene of cardiac ryanodine receptor (RyR2)
Transthoracic echocardiography showed normal cardiac function and structure
response.rationale: Polymorphic VT/VF in a structurally normal heart with a RyR2 variant strongly favors CPVT, whereas ARVC is unlikely given normal cardiac structure and no supporting imaging/desmosomal features.

rejected.why: ARVC is contradicted by normal echocardiography and lacks ARVC-specific structural or desmosomal genetic support; the LBBB-like PVC morphology alone is nonspecific.
